answer: The nectar schedule is applied in copper and willow shows each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 21% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4915 identities would post 604 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
